purpose: Frozen G per proposal v4 §5.1 INV-G-1: per-dimension preservation gates bound only to P, covering both subset-(a) (calibrated BIB 4-dim) and subset-(b) (8 C12 axes).

gates.criterion: G_pres_a + G_pres_b per v0.1 §11.2 — Arm M within-Recon Manhattan mean <= Arm C within-Recon Manhattan mean + 1.5 (G_pres_a), AND Arm M within-Recon Manhattan mean <= 2.5 absolute (G_pres_b).
gates.pass_rule: Both G_pres_a and G_pres_b must PASS for this gate to PASS.
gates.scope_note: The +1.5 Manhattan tolerance applies ONLY to G_pres_a. Arm C validity envelope is not enlarged by the +1.5 (per v0.1 §11.2 PI freeze correction 1, C-1).

gates.evaluator: B (Claude Code CLI claude-opus-4-7, fresh session, blinded)
gates.pass_rule: Both G_pres_a and G_pres_b must PASS for this gate to PASS.

gates.criterion: Each of the 8 axes (C12-1..8) independently evaluated per-axis. A per-axis C12-axis-BROKEN call is a hard fail on that axis.
gates.pass_rule: All 8 axes must PASS (no C12-axis-BROKEN) for this gate to PASS.

gates.evaluator: B (Claude Code CLI claude-opus-4-7, fresh session, blinded)
gates.pass_rule: All 8 axes must PASS (no C12-axis-BROKEN) for this gate to PASS.

aggregation_rule_for_Non_target_Identity: Non-target_Identity_Preservation = G-pres-subset-a-A AND G-pres-subset-a-B AND G-pres-subset-b-A AND G-pres-subset-b-B AND no per-axis C12-axis-BROKEN (per proposal v4 §5.4 STEP 1).
control_validity_pre_check_C20: Before any G evaluation, Arm C must satisfy the frozen BIB non-deviated envelope on its own (no +1.5 tolerance added to Arm C). Arm C failure on C20 -> INVALID_EXPERIMENT (proposal v4 §5.4 pre-check).
evaluator_blinding_manifest: See inputs/acceptance-tests.json evaluator_blinding_manifest; same blinding discipline applies to G evaluators.
